title: What Happens in the Workshop
prompt: The Enchanter meant to drain the reservoir. He wrote this, and the reservoir never moved. Find why.

config.symptom: it prints 100. The drain did nothing at all.

line_hints.0: The reservoir is set correctly here, out in the open where everyone can see it.
line_hints.2: Defining the spell is fine — nothing has gone wrong yet.
line_hints.5: The spell IS being cast. Removing this would not help; the problem is inside it.
line_hints.6: Printing only reports what survived. It is the messenger.

fixes.why: Without it, 'power = 5' quietly forges a NEW power that exists only inside the workshop and vanishes when the spell ends. 'global' says: I mean the one outside.
It would hand a value back — but nobody catches it, and the outer power is still untouched. Returning is not the same as changing.
That asks a question instead of giving an order. It computes True or False, throws it away, and changes nothing.

config.success: A name written inside a workshop stays in the workshop — unless you declare otherwise.
